author: Kat B (AleeriaG)
text: My kitchen sink clogged, backfilling with nasty water and they were able to come out same day with the quoted $160 drain cleaning fee. Once they got here and assessed the sink, they determined that it was actually the garbage disposal which they recommended to replace and dropped the charge to just a $90 service call fee. Quick, painless, and professional. I will be recommending them to any one with drain issues.

author: mb sc
text:
I had an excellent experience with Xtreme Drainworks and Brian. From start to finish, the service was professional, prompt, and efficient. Brian is knowledgeable, courteous, and took the time to source the cause of our blockage, which was beyond our responsibility.

Xtreme Drainworks is a well-equipped company with the right tools on the truck and expertise to handle the job correctly. The quality of their work and response time will always make them the first call on our list for plumbing and drain issues.
